def SelfSimilarRelationalGraph.deinit (self : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph allocator) : Unit :=
  let n_it := self.nodes.iterator

    Node.deinit e.2
  let ed_it := self.edges.iterator

    ArrayList.deinit e.2

def SelfSimilarRelationalGraph.addNode (self : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph allocator) (node_in : Node allocator) : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph allocator :=
  let incoming_id := node_in.id
  match self.nodes.get incoming_id with
  | some existing =>
    let existing' := { existing with data := node_in.data, qubit := node_in.qubit, phase := node_in.phase,
                                   metadata := node_in.metadata }
    let nodes' := self.nodes.put incoming_id existing'
    let qr_key := incoming_id
    let quantum_register' := self.quantum_register.put qr_key node_in.qubit
    { self with nodes := nodes', quantum_register := quantum_register' }
  | none =>
    let nodes' := self.nodes.put node_in.id node_in
    let qr_key := incoming_id
    let quantum_register' := self.quantum_register.put qr_key node_in.qubit
    { self with nodes := nodes', quantum_register := quantum_register' }

def SelfSimilarRelationalGraph.addEdge (self : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph allocator) (source target : String) (edge_in : Edge allocator) : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph allocator :=
  let s := self.canonicalIdPtr source |>. withDefault source
  let t := self.canonicalIdPtr target |>. withDefault target
  let edge := { edge_in with source := s, target := t }
  let key := EdgeKey.mk s t
  let stored := Edge.clone edge self.allocator
  let gop := self.edges.get key
  let list := match gop with
    | some lst => lst
    | none => ArrayList.init self.allocator
  let list' := ArrayList.append list stored
  let edges' := self.edges.put key list'
  { self with edges := edges' }

  match self.nodes.get node_id with

  | some n =>
    let n' := { n with qubit := q }
    let nodes' := self.nodes.put node_id n'
    let quantum_register' := match self.quantum_register.get node_id with
      | some _ => self.quantum_register.put node_id q
      | none => self.quantum_register.put node_id q
    { self with nodes := nodes', quantum_register := quantum_register' }

  | some n =>

def SelfSimilarRelationalGraph.entangleNodes (self : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph allocator) (a_id b_id : String) : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph allocator :=
  let a := self.canonicalIdPtr a_id |>. withDefault a_id
  let b := self.canonicalIdPtr b_id |>. withDefault b_id
  let pk := if String.lt a b then PairKey.mk a b else PairKey.mk b a
  let entanglements' := self.entanglements.put pk TwoQubit.initBellPhiPlus
  let edge_ab := Edge.init self.allocator a b EdgeQuality.entangled 1.0 (Complex.init 1.0 0.0) 0.0
  let edge_ba := Edge.init self.allocator b a EdgeQuality.entangled 1.0 (Complex.init 1.0 0.0) 0.0
  let self' := SelfSimilarRelationalGraph.addEdge { self with entanglements := entanglements' } a b edge_ab
  SelfSimilarRelationalGraph.addEdge self' b a edge_ba

def SelfSimilarRelationalGraph.measure (self : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph allocator) (node_id : String) : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph allocator × UInt1 :=
  let _ := self.canonicalIdPtr node_id
  let it := self.entanglements.iterator
  let hit_key := none
  let hit_val := none
  let found := false
  for e in it do
    if !found && (String.eq e.1.a node_id || String.eq e.1.b node_id) then
      let hit_key := some e.1
      let hit_val := some e.2
      let found := true
  match hit_key, hit_val with
  | some pk, some state =>
    let r := (self.rng % 1000) / 1000.0
    let cum := 0.0
    let outcome := 0
    for i in [0, 1, 2, 3] do
      let amp := state.amps.get! i
      let cum' := cum + amp.magnitudeSquared
      if r ≤ cum' then
        let outcome := i
        break
      else
        let cum := cum'
    let a_id := pk.a
    let b_id := pk.b
    let a_ptr := self.nodes.get a_id |>. withDefault (Node.init self.allocator "" "" Qubit.initBasis0 0.0)
    let b_ptr := self.nodes.get b_id |>. withDefault (Node.init self.allocator "" "" Qubit.initBasis0 0.0)
    let a_qubit := match outcome with
      | 0 => Qubit.initBasis0
      | 1 => Qubit.initBasis0
      | 2 => Qubit.initBasis1
      | _ => Qubit.initBasis1
    let b_qubit := match outcome with
      | 0 => Qubit.initBasis0
      | 1 => Qubit.initBasis1
      | 2 => Qubit.initBasis0
      | _ => Qubit.initBasis1
    let nodes' := self.nodes.put a_id { a_ptr with qubit := a_qubit }.put b_id { b_ptr with qubit := b_qubit }
    let quantum_register' := self.quantum_register.put a_id a_qubit.put b_id b_qubit
    let entanglements' := self.entanglements.remove pk
    let edges' := self.edges
      .adjust (EdgeKey.mk a_id b_id) (fun lst => ArrayList.append (ArrayList.init self.allocator) (lst.items.get? 0 |>. withDefault (Edge.init self.allocator "" "" EdgeQuality.collapsed 0.0 (Complex.init 0.0 0.0) 0.0)))
      .adjust (EdgeKey.mk b_id a_id) (fun lst => ArrayList.append (ArrayList.init self.allocator) (lst.items.get? 0 |>. withDefault (Edge.init self.allocator "" "" EdgeQuality.collapsed 0.0 (Complex.init 0.0 0.0) 0.0)))
    let self' := { self with nodes := nodes', quantum_register := quantum_register', entanglements := entanglements', edges := edges' }
    let bit := if String.eq node_id a_id then (outcome >>> 1) &&& 1 else outcome &&& 1
    (self', bit)
  | none, none =>
    let n := self.nodes.get node_id |>. withDefault (Node.init self.allocator "" "" Qubit.initBasis0 0.0)
    let p0 := n.qubit.prob0
    let r0 := (self.rng % 1000) / 1000.0
    let bit := if r0 ≤ p0 then 0 else 1
    let qubit' := if bit = 0 then Qubit.initBasis0 else Qubit.initBasis1
    let nodes' := self.nodes.put node_id { n with qubit := qubit' }
    let quantum_register' := self.quantum_register.put node_id qubit'
    let self' := { self with nodes := nodes', quantum_register := quantum_register' }
    (self', bit)

structure EdgeKey where
  source : String
  target : String

instance : DecidableEq EdgeKey where
  decEq a b := if h1 : a.source == b.source then
    if h2 : a.target == b.target then
      isTrue (by cases h1; cases h2; rfl)
    else
      isFalse (fun h => EdgeKey.noConfusion h h2)
  else
    isFalse (fun h => EdgeKey.noConfusion h h1)

def Wyhash.init (seed : UInt64) : UInt64 :=
  seed

def Wyhash.update (h : UInt64) (data : ByteArray) : UInt64 :=
  h ^ data.foldl (· * 31 + ·) 0

def Wyhash.final (h : UInt64) : UInt64 :=
  h

def hashSlice (h : UInt64) (s : String) : UInt64 :=
  let len_buf := ByteArray.ofList (List.map (fun i => (s.length >>> (i * 8)) &&& 0xFF) [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7])
  let h := Wyhash.update h len_buf
  Wyhash.update h (ByteArray.ofString s)

structure EdgeKeyContext where

def EdgeKeyContext.hash (self : EdgeKeyContext) (k : EdgeKey) : UInt64 :=
  let h := Wyhash.init 0
  let h := hashSlice h k.source
  hashSlice h k.target

def EdgeKeyContext.eql (self : EdgeKeyContext) (a b : EdgeKey) : Bool :=
  a.source == b.source && a.target == b.target

structure PairKey where
  a : String
  b : String

instance : DecidableEq PairKey where
  decEq a b := if h1 : a.a == b.a then
    if h2 : a.b == b.b then
      isTrue (by cases h1; cases h2; rfl)
    else
      isFalse (fun h => PairKey.noConfusion h h2)
  else
    isFalse (fun h => PairKey.noConfusion h h1)

structure PairKeyContext where

def PairKeyContext.hash (self : PairKeyContext) (k : PairKey) : UInt64 :=
  let h := Wyhash.init 1
  let h := hashSlice h k.a
  hashSlice h k.b

def PairKeyContext.eql (self : PairKeyContext) (x y : PairKey) : Bool :=
  x.a == y.a && x.b == y.b

structure TwoQubit where
  amps : Array (Complex F64)
  norm_sq : F64 := (amps.map (·.magnitudeSquared)).foldl (· + ·) 0.0
  norm_eq_1 : norm_sq = 1.0

def TwoQubit.initBellPhiPlus : TwoQubit :=
  let inv_sqrt2 := 1.0 / sqrt 2.0
  let amps := #[ Complex.init inv_sqrt2 0.0, Complex.init 0.0 0.0, Complex.init 0.0 0.0, Complex.init inv_sqrt2 0.0 ]
  { amps := amps, norm_sq := 1.0, norm_eq_1 := by
    simp [Array.foldl, List.foldl, List.map, List.sum]
    ring_nf
    have : inv_sqrt2 * inv_sqrt2 = 0.5 := by
      rw [← pow_two, mul_div_cancel' _ (ne_of_gt (by simp [inv_sqrt2]))]
      simp [pow_two, inv_sqrt2]
      ring
    simp [this]
    ring }

def Gate := Qubit → Qubit

def hadamardGate (q : Qubit) : Qubit :=
  let inv_sqrt2 := 1.0 / sqrt 2.0
  let s := Complex.init inv_sqrt2 0.0
  let a := (q.a.add q.b).mul s
  let b := (q.a.sub q.b).mul s
  Qubit.init a b

def pauliXGate (q : Qubit) : Qubit :=
  Qubit.init q.b q.a

def pauliYGate (q : Qubit) : Qubit :=
  let i := Complex.init 0.0 1.0
  let minus_i := Complex.init 0.0 (-1.0)
  Qubit.init (minus_i.mul q.b) (i.mul q.a)

def pauliZGate (q : Qubit) : Qubit :=
  Qubit.init q.a (q.b.mul (Complex.init (-1.0) 0.0))

def identityGate (q : Qubit) : Qubit :=
  q

def phaseGate (phase : F64) : Gate :=
  fun q =>
    let c := cos phase
    let s := sin phase
    let e := Complex.init c s
    Qubit.init q.a (q.b.mul e)

def SelfSimilarRelationalGraph.addNode (self : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph allocator) (node_in : Node allocator) : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph allocator :=
  let incoming_id := node_in.id
  match self.nodes.get incoming_id with
  | some existing =>
    let existing' := { existing with data := node_in.data, qubit := node_in.qubit, phase := node_in.phase,
                                   metadata := node_in.metadata }
    let nodes' := self.nodes.put incoming_id existing'
    let qr_key := incoming_id
    let quantum_register' := self.quantum_register.put qr_key node_in.qubit
    { self with nodes := nodes', quantum_register := quantum_register' }
  | none =>
    let nodes' := self.nodes.put node_in.id node_in
    let qr_key := incoming_id
    let quantum_register' := self.quantum_register.put qr_key node_in.qubit
    { self with nodes := nodes', quantum_register := quantum_register' }

  let s := self.canonicalIdPtr source |>. withDefault source
  let t := self.canonicalIdPtr target |>. withDefault target
  let edge := { edge_in with source := s, target := t }
  let key := EdgeKey.mk s t
  let stored := Edge.clone edge self.allocator
  let gop := self.edges.get key
  let list := match gop with
    | some lst => lst
    | none => ArrayList.init self.allocator
  let list' := ArrayList.append list stored
  let edges' := self.edges.put key list'
  { self with edges := edges' }

def SelfSimilarRelationalGraph.entangleNodes (self : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph allocator) (a_id b_id : String) : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph allocator :=
  let a := self.canonicalIdPtr a_id |>. withDefault a_id
  let b := self.canonicalIdPtr b_id |>. withDefault b_id
  let pk := if String.lt a b then PairKey.mk a b else PairKey.mk b a
  let entanglements' := self.entanglements.put pk TwoQubit.initBellPhiPlus
  let edge_ab := Edge.init self.allocator a b EdgeQuality.entangled 1.0 (Complex.init 1.0 0.0) 0.0
  let edge_ba := Edge.init self.allocator b a EdgeQuality.entangled 1.0 (Complex.init 1.0 0.0) 0.0
  let self' := SelfSimilarRelationalGraph.addEdge { self with entanglements := entanglements' } a b edge_ab
  SelfSimilarRelationalGraph.addEdge self' b a edge_ba

def SelfSimilarRelationalGraph.measure (self : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph allocator) (node_id : String) : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph allocator × UInt1 :=
  let _ := self.canonicalIdPtr node_id
  let it := self.entanglements.iterator
  let hit_key := none
  let hit_val := none
  let found := false
  for e in it do
    if !found && (String.eq e.1.a node_id || String.eq e.1.b node_id) then
      let hit_key := some e.1
      let hit_val := some e.2
      let found := true
  match hit_key, hit_val with
  | some pk, some state =>
    let r := (self.rng % 1000) / 1000.0
    let cum := 0.0
    let outcome := 0
    for i in [0, 1, 2, 3] do
      let amp := state.amps.get! i
      let cum' := cum + amp.magnitudeSquared
      if r ≤ cum' then
        let outcome := i
        break
      else
        let cum := cum'
    let a_id := pk.a
    let b_id := pk.b
    let a_ptr := self.nodes.get a_id |>. withDefault (Node.init self.allocator "" "" Qubit.initBasis0 0.0)
    let b_ptr := self.nodes.get b_id |>. withDefault (Node.init self.allocator "" "" Qubit.initBasis0 0.0)
    let a_qubit := match outcome with
      | 0 => Qubit.initBasis0
      | 1 => Qubit.initBasis0
      | 2 => Qubit.initBasis1
      | _ => Qubit.initBasis1
    let b_qubit := match outcome with
      | 0 => Qubit.initBasis0
      | 1 => Qubit.initBasis1
      | 2 => Qubit.initBasis0
      | _ => Qubit.initBasis1
    let nodes' := self.nodes.put a_id { a_ptr with qubit := a_qubit }.put b_id { b_ptr with qubit := b_qubit }
    let quantum_register' := self.quantum_register.put a_id a_qubit.put b_id b_qubit
    let entanglements' := self.entanglements.remove pk
    let edges' := self.edges
      .adjust (EdgeKey.mk a_id b_id) (fun lst => ArrayList.append (ArrayList.init self.allocator) (lst.items.get? 0 |>. withDefault (Edge.init self.allocator "" "" EdgeQuality.collapsed 0.0 (Complex.init 0.0 0.0) 0.0)))
      .adjust (EdgeKey.mk b_id a_id) (fun lst => ArrayList.append (ArrayList.init self.allocator) (lst.items.get? 0 |>. withDefault (Edge.init self.allocator "" "" EdgeQuality.collapsed 0.0 (Complex.init 0.0 0.0) 0.0)))
    let self' := { self with nodes := nodes', quantum_register := quantum_register', entanglements := entanglements', edges := edges' }
    let bit := if String.eq node_id a_id then (outcome >>> 1) &&& 1 else outcome &&& 1
    (self', bit)
  | none, none =>
    let n := self.nodes.get node_id |>. withDefault (Node.init self.allocator "" "" Qubit.initBasis0 0.0)
    let p0 := n.qubit.prob0
    let r0 := (self.rng % 1000) / 1000.0
    let bit := if r0 ≤ p0 then 0 else 1
    let qubit' := if bit = 0 then Qubit.initBasis0 else Qubit.initBasis1
    let nodes' := self.nodes.put node_id { n with qubit := qubit' }
    let quantum_register' := self.quantum_register.put node_id qubit'
    let self' := { self with nodes := nodes', quantum_register := quantum_register' }
    (self', bit)
